t: From September 11 to 13, President of Russia will visit India to attend the BRICS Summit
d: From September 11 to 13, President Vladimir Putin will pay a working visit to the Republic of India to attend the 18th BRICS Summit. The event will be held in New Delhi, as the association marks its 20th anniversary.
